# Changelog

All notable changes to this plugin will be documented here.

## 1.0.0 — initial release

- Added the `embarko` MCP server pointing at Embarko's hosted endpoint (`https://mcp.embarko.ai/mcp`).
- Auth uses OAuth with an Embarko account sign-in.
- Logo: the submitted icon URL (`https://embarko.ai/assets/embarko-icon.svg`), referenced as an absolute URL because embarko.ai could not be reached when the plugin was added.
